readings.title: Cities of Judah
readings.subtitle: The Inheritance of the Tribe
readings.text: [Joshua 15:20] This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yehudah according to their clans: [21] And the cities at the limits of the tribe of the children of Yehudah, toward the border of Edom in the South, were Qabtsě’ĕl, and Eder, and Yagur, [22] and Qinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah, [23] and Qedesh, and Ḥatsor, and Yithnan, [24] Ziph, and Telem, and Be‛aloth, [25] and Ḥatsor Ḥadattah, and Qeriyoth, Ḥetsron, which is Ḥatsor, [26] Amam, and Shema, and Moladah, [27] and Ḥatsar Gaddah, and Ḥeshmon, and Beyth Pelet, [28] and Ḥatsar Shu‛al, and Be’ĕrsheba, and Bizyothyah, [29] Ba‛alah, and Iyyim, and Etsem, [30] and Eltolad, and Kesil, and Ḥormah, [31] and Tsiqlaḡ, and Madmannah, and Sansannah, [32] and Leba’oth, and Shilḥim, and Ayin, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages. [33] In the low country: Eshta’ol, and Tsor‛ah, and Ashnah, [34] and Zanoaḥ, and Eyn Gannim, Tappuaḥ, and Enam, [35] Yarmuth, and Adullam, Soḵoh, and Azěqah, [36] and Sha‛arayim, and Adithayim, and Gederah, and Gederothayim: fourteen cities with their villages. [37] Tsenan, and Ḥadashah, and Miḡdal Gad, [38] and Dil‛an, and Mitspah, and Yoqthe’ĕl, [39] Lakhish, and Botsqath, and Eglon, [40] and Kabbon, and Laḥmas, and Kithlish, [41] and Gederoth, Beyth Dagon, and Na‛amah, and Maqqědah: sixteen cities with their villages. [42] Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan, [43] and Yiphtaḥ, and Ashnah, and Netsib, [44] and Qe‛ilah, and Aḵzib, and Marěshah: nine cities with their villages. [45] Eqron, with its towns and its villages; [46] from Eqron to the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages; [47] Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Azzah, its towns and its villages; as far as the wadi of Mitsrayim and the Great Sea with its coastline. [48] And in the mountain country: Shamir, and Yattir, and Soḵoh, [49] and Dannah, and Qiryath Sannah, which is Debir, [50] and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim, [51] and Goshen, and Ḥolon, and Giloh: eleven cities with their villages. [52] Arab, and Dumah, and Esh‛an, [53] and Yanim, and Beyth Tappuaḥ, and Apheqah, [54] and Ḥumtah, and Qiryath Arba, which is Ḥebron, and Tsi‛or: nine cities with their villages. [55] Ma‛on, Karmel, and Ziph, and Yuṭṭah, [56] and Yizre‛ĕl, and Yoqde‛am, and Zanoaḥ, [57] Qayin, Gib‛ah, and Timnah: ten cities with their villages. [58] Ḥalḥul, Beyth Tsur, and Gedor, [59] and Ma‛arath, and Beyth Anoth, and Elteqon: six cities with their villages. [60] Qiryath Ba‛al, which is Qiryath Ye‛arim, and Rabbah: two cities with their villages. [61] In the wilderness: Beyth Arabah, Middin, and Seḵaḵah, [62] and Nibshan, and the City of Salt, and Eyn Gedi: six cities with their villages. [63] As for the Yebusites, the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, the children of Yehudah were unable to drive them out. So the Yebusites dwell with the children of Yehudah at Yerushalayim to this day.

readings.title: Inheritance of Ephraim
readings.subtitle: The Portion of Joseph
readings.text: [Joshua 16:1] And the lot fell to the children of Yoseph from the Yarden, by Yeriḥo, to the waters of Yeriḥo on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Yeriḥo through the mountains to Beyth Ěl, [2] then went out from Beyth Ěl to Luz, and passed over to the border of the Arkites at Ataroth, [3] and went down westward to the boundary of the Yaphletites, as far as the boundary of Lower Beyth Ḥoron to Gezer, and it ended at the sea. [4] So the children of Yoseph, Menashsheh and Ephrayim, took their inheritance. [5] And the border of the children of Ephrayim, according to their clans, was: The border of their inheritance on the east side was Atroth Addar as far as Upper Beyth Ḥoron. [6] And the border went out toward the sea on the north side of Miḵmethath, then the border turned eastward to Ta‛anath Shiloh, and passed it on the east of Yanoḥah, [7] and went down from Yanoḥah to Ataroth and Na‛arah, and touched Yeriḥo and came out at the Yarden. [8] The border went out from Tappuaḥ westward to the wadi Qanah, and it ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephrayim for their clans. [9] And the separate cities for the children of Ephrayim were in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Menashsheh, all the cities with their villages. [10] And they did not drive out the Kena‛anites who dwelt in Gezer, so the Kena‛anites dwell in the midst of Ephrayim to this day, and have become compulsory labourers.

readings.title: Inheritance of Manasseh
readings.subtitle: The Daughters of Tselophḥad
readings.text: [Joshua 17:1] And the lot was for the tribe of Menashsheh, for he was the first-born of Yoseph: for Maḵir the first-born of Menashsheh, father of Gil‛ad, because he was a man of war. Therefore he was given Gil‛ad and Bashan. [2] And there was a lot for the rest of the children of Menashsheh according to their clans: for the children of Abi‛ezer, and for the children of Ḥeleq, and for the children of Asri’ĕl, and for the children of Sheḵem, and for the children of Ḥepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Menashsheh son of Yoseph according to their clans. [3] But Tselophḥad, son of Ḥepher, son of Gil‛ad, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, had no sons, but only daughters. And these are the names of his daughters: Maḥlah, and No‛ah, Ḥoglah, Milkah, and Tirtsah. [4] And they came near before El‛azar the priest, and before Yehoshua son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers. [5] And ten portions fell to Menashsheh, besides the land of Gil‛ad and Bashan, which were beyond the Yarden, [6] because the daughters of Menashsheh received an inheritance among his sons. And the rest of Menashsheh’s sons had the land of Gil‛ad.

readings.title: Manasseh's Territory
readings.subtitle: Borders and Challenges
readings.text: [Joshua 17:7] And the territory of Menashsheh was from Asher to Miḵmethath, which lies east of Sheḵem, and the border went along south to the inhabitants of Eyn Tappuaḥ. [8] The land of Tappuaḥ belonged to Menashsheh, but Tappuaḥ on the border of Menashsheh belonged to the children of Ephrayim. [9] And the border went down to the wadi Qanah, south of the wadi. These cities of Ephrayim are in the midst of the cities of Menashsheh. And the border of Menashsheh was on the north side of the wadi, and it ended at the sea. [10] Southward it was Ephrayim’s, and northward it was Menashsheh’s, and the sea was its border. And they met Asher on the north and Yissasḵar on the east. [11] And in Yissasḵar and in Asher, Menashsheh had Beyth She’an and its towns, and Yible‛am and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Eyn Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Ta‛anaḵ and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns – three of the heights. [12] But the children of Menashsheh were unable to drive out the inhabitants of those cities, for the Kena‛anites persisted to dwell in that land. [13] And it came to be, when the children of Yisra’el were strong, that they put the Kena‛anites to compulsory labour, but did not utterly drive them out.

readings.title: Expansion of Joseph
readings.subtitle: Clearing the Forest Country
readings.text: [Joshua 17:14] And the children of Yoseph spoke to Yehoshua, saying, “Why have you given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has blessed me until now?” [15] And Yehoshua answered them, “If you are a great people, go up to the forest country and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the Repha’im, since the mountains of Ephrayim are too confined for you.” [16] And the children of Yoseph said, “The mountain is not enough for us. And all the Kena‛anites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are of Beyth She’an and its towns and those who are of the Valley of Yizre‛ĕl.” [17] And Yehoshua spoke to the house of Yoseph, to Ephrayim and to Menashsheh, saying, “You are a great people and have great power, you shall not have one lot only, [18] but the mountain shall be yours. For it is a forest, and you shall cut it down, and its farthest limits shall be yours. For you are to drive out the Kena‛anites, though they have iron chariots and are strong.”
